headline: US stocks drift near their records as oil prices rise
summary: The U.S. stock market is drifting near its all-time high on Monday, while oil prices rise on uncertainty about when the Strait of Hormuz could reopen and get the global flow of crude going again.  The S&P 500 was virtually unchanged after flipping between small gains and losses, coming off its record set on Friday.  Reports are on track to show earnings per share for companies in the S&P 500 were 50% higher in the spring from a year earlier, according to FactSet.
